title: Sort Four Integers

content.problemStatement: Write a program to take 4 integers inputs and print it in ascending order

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input '10 30 40 20' produces expected output '' following problem rules.
Input '54 23 90 1' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.approach: Read 4 integers and print them sorted in ascending order separated by space.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Store the 4 integers in an array, sort ascending, and print separated by space.

hints: Sort them using an array or list sort method.
Output the sorted numbers joined by spaces.
